findings.title: Verification via a selector the precompile does not implement

findings.title: Generator returns null on failure, read upstream as absence
findings.note: A scan that throws and returns null cannot be distinguished from a scan that found nothing. If null means 'no payment' anywhere upstream, a dead RPC manufactures a negative result.

findings.title: Generator zeroes the proof on failure but still reports success
findings.note: The proof generation failed, the proof was blanked, and the result still claims success. A consumer trusting that flag acts on an empty proof.
